blocks.text: AI product staging tool that generates branded backgrounds and scenes

Pebblely solves the part of product photography that comes after the garment is already cut out: staging it in a scene that looks intentional. Upload a product photo and choose from 40 or more AI-generated background themes, and Pebblely composites the product into a scene that matches your brand.
For teams processing a catalog rather than a single hero shot, Pebblely's bulk mode handles up to 25 products at once, which turns a day of scene-setting into a few minutes of review.
AI-generated scenes and lifestyle backdrops for product photos
Stage up to 25 products in a single batch
Consistent staging across a full product catalog
Pebblely pairs well with a garment cutout tool like remove.bg: once a product is isolated, Pebblely's background library gets it into a coherent, on-brand scene without a physical set.
Our team can integrate Pebblely into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
